record.question: The Ministry of Food Processing Industries, Government of India implements the Pradhan Mantri Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises Scheme (PMFME) with the aim of supporting:
record.explanation: Answer A: 'Vocal for local' campaign. The PMFME scheme was framed under the Vocal for Local initiative. Reference: https://www.mofpi.gov.in/sites/default/files/booklet_mofpi_pmfme_-_2021_eng.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: October 2025 examination (cover page); answer time-sensitive wording as of then..
